notice_email.subject: GA on Oct 12: proposal to raise the food budget by 10%
notice_email.body:
Hi everyone,

Our next General Assembly is planned for Oct 12. The main item is a proposal to raise the house food budget by 10%.

A few things to know:
- Our bylaws (Section 2.2) require 7 days' notice, and this notice is going out with only 5 days to spare. The officers may need to move the GA to Oct 14 or later.
- Because this changes the budget by more than 5%, the Finance Committee must review it by Oct 9 (Section 3.3).
- The motion needs a two-thirds majority. Section 3.3 doesn't say whether that's two-thirds of members present or of all members, so we'll settle that first.
- We need at least 21 members present for quorum, so please come!

Questions? Reply to this email.

[Your name], on behalf of the officers
